The build-up of toxic substances in organisms as they move up the food chain

questions.explanation: Bioaccumulation is the build-up of toxic substances (such as pesticides or heavy metals) in the tissues of organisms. As these substances pass along food chains, they become more concentrated at each trophic level, a process called biomagnification.
